text: For a succeeding dislike spoils the best of actions, and repentance makes that which was never so well done, become base and faulty; whereas the choice that is founded upon knowledge and wise reasoning, does not change by disappointment, or suffer us to repent, though it happen perchance to be less prosperous in the issue.
author: Plutarch
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
